shared_elements: vertical rectangular stone slab as carving field
shallow low-relief carving on rough stone
narrow band or register of repeated motifs
carving organised in horizontal rows along one edge
justification: Both are upright rectangular stone panels bearing shallow, schematic low-relief profile animals, discs and a narrow banded register, which gives them a comparable technique and repertoire of generic motifs. The arrangement differs markedly: A distributes its imagery in stacked registers across the whole face with a dominant top row and large central animals, whereas B confines its carving to a narrow strip along the left and lower margins, leaving a broad blank, pitted centre.
